subject: Temporary no-PO onboarding for Velocis AI pilot
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@velocis.ai>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Velocis is excited to try Redwood’s hosted inference for a 3-week pilot. Procurement asked whether we can onboard under an invoice-only (no PO) flow during the pilot period to avoid internal PO cycle delays.

We can commit to monthly invoices, provide SOC2 evidence, and sign a short addendum if that helps. Estimated spend for the pilot is ~USD 3,200.

Can Redwood support a temporary no-PO lane for pilots under $5k with a short evidence package? If so, what does Redwood need from us (forms, attestations, signature)?

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, Velocis AI
M: +1 415-555-0198

--
Velocis AI (external)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot

Team — forwarding Velocis’ ask. Pilot spend ~3.2k and they can provide SOC2 evidence and a short addendum. Quick proposal from my side: allow a temporary invoice-only lane for pilots <= $5k for up to 30 days, with an evidence checklist and a named approver in procurement.

Please review procurement guardrails and onboarding form updates below:
- Evidence checklist: SOC2 report OR recent security questionnaire, point of contact, billing contact, and expected monthly invoice frequency.
- Operational guardrails: invoice-only for pilots <= $5k, auto-archive of invoices into customer folder, 30-day max, audit log enabled.
- Contract: short addendum (1 paragraph) that binds them to Redwood’s terms for the pilot and confirms data handling and retention.

David — can procurement sign off on risk controls if we get the evidence pack? Marissa — can we add the checklist to the onboarding form and prepare a DocuSign addendum template?

Thanks,
Soojin
Director, GTM Ops — Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot

Agree in principle but want concrete guardrails before approving an exception. Feedback from procurement:

1) Threshold & duration: OK for pilots <= $5k and <= 30 days; any extension requires formal PO or escalation.
2) Billing cadence: monthly invoices only; Net-15 for pilot invoices.
3) Evidence required prior to activation: either SOC2 Type II attestation from last 18 months OR completed security questionnaire + two reference customers.
4) Controls: invoice routing tag 'pilot-no-po', KYC on billing contact, and payments team notified for reconciliation.
5) Audit & retention: retain evidence + invoices for 3 years; procurement will run a one-time audit within first 90 days.

I attached a short draft of the guardrails I’d like to lock in. If the external can meet these, procurement will enable an exception lane.

Attachment: proposed_guardrails_v1.pdf

-David
Procurement Manager
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot

This looks doable. I’ll update the supplier intake form and the onboarding checklist to include the specific evidence fields David listed. Proposed changes:
- New checkbox group on intake form: SOC2 provided / Security questionnaire attached / Two refs provided.
- Billing contact fields mandatory when requesting no-PO lane.
- Add a one-click workflow that drops the evidence package into our shared Drive and attaches the 'pilot-no-po' tag to the account.

I’ve started an evidence checklist workbook — attaching a working copy. Once procurement signs the guardrails we can present the checklist to Velocis and route the DocuSign addendum.

Attachment: evidence_checklist_for_no_po_lane.xlsx

Marissa
Senior Onboarding PM
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@velocis.ai>, Velocis Procurement <procurement@velocis.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Temporary no-PO onboarding for pilot

Hi Marta — thanks for the quick note and willingness to share evidence. Good news: procurement is prepared to enable a temporary invoice-only lane for pilot engagements under $5k, subject to the guardrails below. If you can provide the listed evidence we’ll activate your pilot onboarding in 48 hours.

What we need from Velocis (action items):
- Provide SOC2 Type II report (last 18 months) OR complete the attached security questionnaire and supply two reference customers (names + contact emails).
- Confirm billing contact and billing email for invoicing.
- Sign the one-paragraph DocuSign addendum that we’ll send (pilot duration, invoice-only, data handling).

Operational guardrails (Redwood):
- Pilot spend cap: USD 5,000 total during the pilot window.
- Duration: up to 30 days; any extension requires PO or procurement escalation.
- Billing cadence: single invoice at pilot completion or monthly if multiple runs; Net-15.
- Evidence retention: we’ll retain the package + invoices for 3 years; procurement may run one audit within 90 days.

Next steps: Marissa will upload the checklist to a shared Drive and I’ll send a DocuSign link once you confirm which evidence route you prefer.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.example/Velocis-Onboard-123

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, GTM Ops — Redwood Inference
